props:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production overworld prop atlas for original folklore spirit RPG TINIKAMI: THE UNWRITTEN ROAD. Create ONE strict 8 columns by 4 rows PNG sprite sheet, 2048x1024, 32 equally sized cells. Flat uniform MAGENTA #FF00FF background for game-engine chroma key, no checkerboard. Every prop fully isolated inside its 256px cell with 24px padding; base anchored at y=220. Crisp pixel-art, broad readable clusters, dark desaturated plum outlines, cream highlights, muted jade foliage, dusty teal roofs, amber windows, red shrine ribbons. Orthographic three-quarter top-down game view, no vanishing-point perspective. No text, no labels, no borders. Original, warm, mysterious handcrafted miniature world.
Row 1, left to right: small moss-roof cottage with smoking chimney; larger turquoise-roof inn with amber windows; red wooden wayside shrine; stone archway with hanging bell; wooden footbridge horizontal; wooden footbridge vertical; small covered market stall; old stone library with crescent window.
Row 2: broad low-noise dark jade tree canopy with visible trunk; flowering orchard tree; pale blue frosted pine; autumn red maple; twisted bare black tree; leaning coastal pine; basalt rock formation; clump of tall reeds.
Row 3: tiny wayfarer in ivory cloak and terracotta scarf facing down; same wayfarer walk stride down; wayfarer right; wayfarer walking right; wayfarer back facing up; wayfarer back walking up; wayfarer left; wayfarer walking left. Same designed protagonist, small dark hair, satchel, copper bell staff, friendly practical clothing, entire body, large enough to read.
Row 4: old female keeper with jade shawl; young rival in dark violet travelling coat; cheerful ferryman in straw hat; scholar in blue robe holding paper; softly glowing jade spirit lantern; three little bronze wind bells on wooden rack; sealed amber treasure chest; large ivory lotus shrine with eight petals.
Beautiful cohesive actual usable sprites, consistent cell boundaries, no background scene.
atlas:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: illustrated world atlas and title-screen background for original spirit-collecting RPG TINIKAMI: THE UNWRITTEN ROAD.
Create a beautiful wide 3:2 pixel-art illustrated map of a continuous pastoral island, viewed from high overhead with charming miniature architecture. No text, no letters, no labels, no UI, no border. A long winding ivory road connects EIGHT distinct regions, arranged in two broad arcs: southwest a warm moss-roof village beside a lotus pond; west-center a teal reed marsh with tiny ferries and bridges; northwest copper windmills on a grassy high ridge; north-center a flowering orchard with a giant old tree; northeast an amber furnace town among dark volcanic stone; east-center a pale blue mountain library and snow pines; southeast a dark indigo coast with a lighthouse and curling ink-like tide; at the island's center a quiet ivory tower with eight bell ropes, a small warm window, and a circular garden.
Art direction: polished old handheld RPG pixel illustration at battle-sprite resolution, original folklore, broad clean clusters, subtle visible pixels, quiet painterly color organization without noisy high-frequency texture. Soft desaturated jade, dusty teal, lavender dusk, parchment paths, tiny vermilion shrine ribbons, warm amber light. Strong distinct regional silhouettes. Deep navy surrounding sea, gently broken shore, a few clouds framing upper corners. Emphasize composition, breathing room, a world one wants to explore. Leave the upper 15 percent mostly quiet dark sky/sea for the engine's title overlay. No existing franchise characters or recognizable copyrighted landmarks. No people or monsters.
